quarterly_data.signal: Element Solutions' Q2 2026 earnings release, Electronics segment as a whole (a mixed segment; the release does not split it by end market). For the three months ended June 30, 2026 versus 2025, Electronics net sales ex-metals were $449.6 million versus $326.0 million (+38%), with pass-through metals of $317.4 million versus $113.4 million (+180%). Electronics adjusted EBITDA was $141.5 million versus $96.5 million (+47%; +44% on a constant currency basis, with the Micromax business having a positive impact of 31% on constant currency adjusted EBITDA growth), and its adjusted EBITDA margin was 31.5% versus 29.6%.
